info.title: API.SH: Musinsa
info.description: The Musinsa API from API.SH: public Musinsa data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Musinsa category tree for a search, brand or category
get.description:
The category tree (code, name, parent, sub-categories) that has products for a keyword, a brand or a parent category, as the filter panel shows it. Use the codes as `category` in /musinsa/v1/search and /musinsa/v1/ranking.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musinsa-categories

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search text. One of keyword, brand or category is required.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Musinsa product: name (Korean and English), style number, sale status, brand (name, country, founding year, logo), final, list, sale and coupon price with discount rate (KRW), category and path, genders, season, rating and review count, total page views and purchases, labels, exclusive flag, delivery (type, release and arrival dates, cut-off), courier and returns, materials (fit, thickness...), ranking history, option groups (size, color...) and sellable variants, images, description HTML and seller company details, plus the site's records in `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musinsa-product

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The latest 10 buyer questions on a product page (type, title, question, date, masked user id, answer status, the seller's answer and date) and the total number of questions. Private questions come back with the text hidden, as on the site.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musinsa-questions

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Musinsa's ranking boards: rank, product id, name, link, brand, final and list price, discount rate, sold-out flag, badges (units sold), live activity notes (viewers, buyers) and image, for a board (all, new, rising, a style such as street or minimal, or the outlet, kids and boutique stores' own boards), a category, gender, age band and period.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musinsa-ranking

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Ranking board (default all). outlet, kids and boutique return those stores' main board (category is ignored).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category code (default 000 = all; 001 tops, 002 outerwear, 003 pants, 103 shoes...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A product's reviews: id, type (general, style, photo), rating, text, purchased option, date, likes, comments, photos, reviewer nickname, level, gender, height and weight when shared. Page 1 adds the summary (total, average rating, photo, style, general and last-month counts). Sort by most helpful, newest, highest or lowest rating or most comments; photo reviews only. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musinsa-reviews

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Musinsa (Korea's largest fashion store) by keyword, or list a category or a brand, with the listing pages' own filters: gender, category code, brand, color, size, price range, discount rate, store (outlet, kids, boutique, used...), tag, attributes (pattern, material, fit), minimum rating, reviews or likes, on sale, time sale, exclusive, coupon, fast delivery, include sold out; sorted by popularity, newest, discount, price, reviews or sales (all time, day, week, month, 3 months, year). Each product: id, name, link, brand id and name, final price, list price, sale and coupon price, discount rate (KRW), rating (0-100) and review count, gender, sold-out, lowest-price and ad flags, image, and the site's original record in `raw`. Up to 100 per page. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (with no other params); null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musinsa-search

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search text (Korean or English). Optional when `category` or `brand` is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Musinsa category code, e.g. 001 (tops), 002 (outerwear), 003 (pants), 103 (shoes), 103004 (sneakers); see /musinsa/v1/categories. Comma-separate for several.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand id as in the site's brand links (nike, musinsastandard, adidas); comma-separate for several.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color code(s) as the site uses them, e.g. BLACK, WHITE, NAVY (comma-separated).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size filter value as the site uses it.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store code, e.g. outlet, kids, boutique, beauty, used.

parameters.name: attribute
parameters.description: Attribute value code(s) from the site's attribute filter.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (send it alone).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Musinsa related keywords and brand matches
get.description:
Related search keywords and matching brands (id, name, link, logo, exclusive and flagship flags) for a search text, as the search box suggests them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musinsa-suggest

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
